# Numbers

*Generated by `Scripts/Build Library.py` on 2026-10-18. Do not edit by hand; add posts to the library and rebuild.*

**Sample.** 116 swiped posts. 116 had slide copy that parsed; 6 of those are sampled-only posts that keep just a few slides, so they are left out of every per-slide figure and counted only for slide count, cover, CTA and tags. Columns: posts 1-71 (the first read), later posts, and all.

**How to read these.** Every figure came from a script reading the slide copy, so treat it as +/-5 points. Cover angle, CTA kind and offer, device tags and headings are pattern-detected, not hand-labelled. Genre is hand-labelled in `Library/Original Index.md`. A number says what winners did on average. It never says what the current idea needs. **If a number and the idea disagree, the idea wins.** Never use any figure as a quota.

Sample sizes: 1-71 = 65 posts, 72-116 = 45 posts, All = 110 posts.

The copy carries no typography, so the main headline is read as the first sentence or phrase and the subheadline as everything after it. Image descriptions, handles and covers over 40 words (post 43 is a story) are left out.

Self-correction, objection-answered and script-shown are matched on fixed phrases, so they undercount. The Tinna Loaiza data finds one self-undercut in almost every post, which a phrase match cannot see.

## 8. Claims and proof

### How often a claim is backed straight away

| Measure | 1-71 | 72-116 | All |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claim slides followed or backed within one slide by a number, quote, example or reason | 83% | 82% | 82% |
| Claim slides counted | 117 | 99 | 216 |
| Body slides that carry evidence (digit, quote, example, because) | 67% | 73% | 70% |
| Posts with a proof number by slide 3 | 35% | 42% | 38% |

A claim cue is a strong word (always, never, most people, nobody, the only, guarantee). Evidence is anything checkable on the same or next slide. This is a rough floor: borrowed proof, analogies and logic carry no digits, so the real rate is higher. See Reference/Rules.md R3.
